channel.title: Daybrief
channel.description: AI first. Everything else that matters, twice a day.

item.title: ZiChuanLan/agent-purge: One persona, many coding agents. Replace or inject system prompts across codex, claude, opencode, grok, omp…
item.description: agent-purge replaces or injects one persona's system prompt across many coding agents, such as Claude, Codex and OpenCode, through a local web console. It supports replace, append and off modes, and changes can be fully reversed. Why it matters: Gives AI agent users one place to manage system prompts across several coding agents.

item.title: Man, 43, allegedly hit police car, ran multiple traffic lights in Marina Bay, drove without licence, to be charged
item.description: A 43-year-old man will be charged for allegedly fleeing a police check, colliding with a police car, running red lights and driving without a licence.

item.title: Backbase Launches Delivery Factory with AI Agents for Banks
item.description: Backbase launched Delivery Factory, an AI-powered software development platform that lets banking delivery teams work alongside specialised AI agents. Backbase says teams using it delivered projects twice as fast as traditional teams. Why it matters: Shows AI agents moving into bank software development, a trend for AI and fintech readers.

item.title: European shares fall as HSBC weighs, France protests keep investors wary
item.description: European shares fell on Tuesday as HSBC's weaker-than-expected revenue weighed on banks and ongoing protests in France kept investors cautious.

item.title: BofA raises Talen Energy stock price target on acquisition benefits
Your Android phone may remember AI chats you thought you deleted
item.description: Researchers at Georgia Tech built a forensic tool that recovers deleted conversations from locally run AI apps on Android phones.

item.title: Funds holding a slice of Anthropic are drawing inflows. SpaceX déjà vu?
During crises, youths will provide psychological first aid, help communities be more resilient
item.description: Singapore launched a 30-member voluntary youth programme, trained in psychological first aid to support peers and build community resilience.

item.title: iPhone 18e specs leak, and Android phones still have the upper hand with this key feature
item.description: Leaked specs suggest the iPhone 18e will keep a 60Hz, 6.12-inch screen and a single 48MP rear camera, with a launch expected in 2027.

item.title: Nvidia to invest $3 billion in Meta as tech giants deepen AI partnership
item.description: Nvidia said it will invest $3 billion in Meta, as Meta plans to raise $95 billion to fund its AI infrastructure investments.

item.title: BALMUDA's Personal AI Radio Feature Delivered to 'The Clock' Every Morning
item.description: BALMUDA will launch a beta of its personal AI radio, "Good Morning Radio", for The Clock on November 2, recruiting 1,000 early-access listeners.

item.title: Beijing pushes for UN-led governance of artificial intelligence at global forum
item.description: China pushes UN-led AI governance and open-source cooperation at a Xiong'an forum attended by delegates from over 90 countries.

item.title: OpenAI announces new discoveries in mathematics, computer science and physics
item.description: OpenAI says its models generated a proof that the Exponential Time Hypothesis is false, and has released new math, computer science and physics results.

item.title: Nasdaq adds APAC fintech leadership in Singapore
item.description: Nasdaq has made new fintech leadership appointments in Singapore, strengthening its presence there as it offers index products in Asia-Pacific.

item.title: Nvidia Invests $3 Billion in Meta in Deeper AI Partnership
item.description: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering and expand its Muse partnership, including Meta deploying more Vera Rubin hardware. It comes as Meta seeks up to $95 billion through stock offerings. Why it matters: Deepens Nvidia's tie to Meta's AI agent app and models, relevant to AI and markets readers.

item.title: Sarvam signs AI framework with Indian defense forces
item.description: Sarvam signs an AI framework with Indian defence forces, and a firewalled division named Chanakya will carry out the defence AI projects.

item.title: Binance files for Brazil crypto license ahead of Friday deadline
item.description: The exchange is delisting 22 crypto assets for Brazilian users and hopes talks with the central bank will allow it to restore some services.

item.title: OCBC named third strongest bank globally in The Asian Banker ranking, DBS is 23rd
item.description: OCBC ranked third globally and strongest in Asia Pacific in The Asian Banker's latest ranking, with DBS placed 23rd.

item.title: ESP32 Rotary Display Makes Ideal Timer
item.description: A Hackaday article covers a Universal Timer on a round ESP32-S3 touchscreen, set with a rotary encoder, plus a buzzer for countdown end.

item.title: AI agents have no rules, so Meta wrote its own
item.description: Meta changed its terms to allow automated crawling of sites tied to Meta Business accounts, with content usable to train its products.

item.title: Scrapy vs BeautifulSoup vs Selenium vs Playwright: which should you use?
item.description: A guide explains that BeautifulSoup parses HTML, Selenium and Playwright drive browsers, and Scrapy manages whole crawls, then gives a beginner decision guide.

item.title: Singapore’s renewed solar push: Hanging panels, clay-like tiles for heritage buildings among plans
item.description: Singapore plans 4GWp of solar by 2035 through measures such as hanging panels, clay-tile-style panels for heritage buildings, and a home-owner portal.

item.title: ST Headstart: Getting ahead in the job hunt
item.description: A Straits Times newsletter covers graduates who went to career fairs and juggled internships early to get ahead in the job hunt.

item.title: Bitcoin ETFs claw back $110M after $774M exit
item.description: US spot Bitcoin ETFs drew $110 million in net inflows Monday after $774 million in outflows, but October stands at about $202 million net outflows.

item.title: Tripling renewable energy capacity by 2030 may still not be enough to meet climate goals: IRENA chief
item.description: IRENA's chief warns the world is nearing its 2030 renewables target of 11.2TW, which may still fall short of climate goals.

item.title: [AINews] Anthropic files for $2T IPO in 2 weeks: 1400% growth rate, 48% of revenue through cloud partners, 85% margin, $1B op profit in Q2, $134B cash in bank and $10B lifetime burn
item.description: Anthropic's IPO filing (S-1) describes its first profitable quarter, and pitches "virtual collaborators" for over a billion knowledge workers by 2028.

item.title: EnterpriseSG to expand agentic AI workshops for SMEs
item.description: EnterpriseSG will run more agentic AI workshops for small businesses in November and expand the series in 2027, following a pilot that supported over 280 firms.

item.title: Singapore, Germany to collaborate on AI use in industries, step up research on new tech
item.description: Singapore and Germany announced a refreshed roadmap to deepen cooperation on industrial AI, digital economy and research. It also covers strengthening ASEAN-EU ties. Why it matters: Shows Singapore deepening AI ties with Europe, with ASEAN-EU links also in view.

item.title: Maritime Coalition Launches Free Vulnerability Database for Ship and Port Systems
item.description: A free public database, Blue Initiative, indexes nearly 30,000 IT and OT vulnerabilities relevant to ships and ports, built by five cyber and maritime organizations.

item.title: Ethereum fixes Glamsterdam bug that could have sent staking deposits to builders
item.description: Ethereum developers patched a flaw in the upcoming Glamsterdam upgrade that could have let someone withdraw ETH meant for new validators; no losses were reported.

item.title: Japan’s trend inflation index hits 3-year high, cements case for BOJ rate hike
item.description: Japan's trend inflation index rose 3.2% year-on-year in September, its fastest pace in three years, strengthening the case for further BOJ rate hikes.

item.title: X is nudging users to promote their posts with a pointing hand, and people are confused
item.description: Users report a mysterious pointing hand over X's promote button while writing posts, confusing and irritating many; X has not explained it.

item.title: The Mythical Man-Month in the Age of AI
item.description: Asks whether Brooks's Law still holds for AI agents, and argues the overhead has shifted to managing agents rather than disappearing.

item.title: Nvidia, Meta deepen AI ties with $3 billion investment deal
item.description: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity offering, deepening work on Meta's Muse AI assistant, which can access users' email, calendar and payments.

item.title: Writing about pratt parsing so I remember it
item.description: The author explains Pratt parsing, which they say conventional computer science courses rarely cover, by relating it to the shunting yard algorithm.

item.title: UK to charge universities $1,200 per international student
item.description: - From August 2028, universities in England will pay an annual levy of £925 for each international student beyond an exemption threshold of 220 students. - The charge applies to…

item.title: Free Claude Code: Use Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, VSCode, Pi, and OpenCode for free from your terminal…
item.description: Describes a way to use Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, VSCode, Pi and OpenCode for free from a terminal, app, IDE or phone (63k stars).

item.title: fswitcher
item.description: fswitcher replaces the Command-Tab app switcher on Mac.

item.title: Nuvio 5.0
item.description: Nuvio 5.0 launches an AI-powered financial management tool for startups that automates invoicing, expenses and reconciliation, and can connect to ChatGPT or Claude.

item.title: OpenRadView
item.description: A free, open-source viewer for your own CT, MRI and X-ray files, with optional AI-agent access; a personal education project, not clinically validated.

item.title: Opening Remarks by Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry (Energy and Industry) Dr Tan See Leng at the Singapore-IRENA High-Level Forum
item.description: At the 6th Singapore-IRENA High-Level Forum, Singapore's Minister for Energy, Trade and Industry said Singapore and the Philippines agreed to explore nuclear energy collaboration.

item.title: ❗️ Claude Opus 5.5 is blocking requests to reverse-engineer smart TVs, a Reddit user says, after a week of…
item.description: A Reddit user says Claude Opus 5.5 blocks requests to reverse-engineer smart TVs, while the same task on a video game still goes through.

item.title: Curso gratis de Claude Code desde cero!
item.description: Aprende a desarrollar en 3 horas con el harness de IA más utilizado: subagentes, comandos personalizados, Skills, MCP, reglas y mucho más. →

item.title: Arcade Controller Pro
item.description: A customizable all-button arcade controller with a compact layout, built-in display, hot-swappable switches, RGB lighting and a magnetic wrist rest, launching today.

item.title: CISA confirms PHP2Shell vulnerabilities now exploited in attacks
item.description: CISA has added two PHP2Shell flaws (CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619) to its catalog of actively exploited vulnerabilities, ordering federal agencies to patch by October 29.

item.title: EmbodiedLab: Benchmarking Embodied Agents That Act to Know
item.description: EmbodiedLab is a benchmark where robots act to know, running 30 physics-based simulated science experiments across five disciplines and reading instruments through cameras.

item.title: S3AC: Stabilized, Selective, and Scalable Actor-Critic for LLM Reasoning
item.description: S3AC is an actor-critic training method for LLM reasoning that reduces rollout waste and outperforms a GRPO variant across model sizes up to 397B parameters.

item.title: JunWan666/astrbot-for-android: Deploy and manage AstrBot and NapCat locally on Android phones, with a built-in PRoot Ubuntu runtime environment, native management interface, WebUI, logs, backup and restore, and independent updates, no root required.
item.description: A Kotlin project for deploying and managing AstrBot and NapCat on Android phones, with a built-in PRoot Ubuntu runtime, backup and restore, and no root required. It has 105 GitHub stars. Why it matters: Shows that AI bot tools can run locally on a phone without root access, relevant to new GitHub projects.

item.title: The 50 top-funded AI startups in Asia
item.description: Here are the AI companies in Asia that have attracted tons of investors and have the resources to spend on software, talent, and expansion.

item.title: INFICON raises full-year guidance as semiconductor demand drives record sales
Novartis ADR earnings beat by $0.18, revenue fell short of estimates
The best PS2 emulator on Android can now make performance tweaks for you
item.description: ARMSX2 v2.9, an Android PS2 emulator, adds performance tuning that tries settings one at a time and keeps only those that speed up a game.

item.title: No further compromise to Alliance Medinet’s system, hacker access blocked, says parent company
item.description: Alliance Healthcare Group says the breach of Alliance Medinet's membership database, which affected about 110,000 members, is contained, with KPMG investigating.

item.title: OpenAI unveils 'GPT-6.1 Terra,' which handles PC operation quickly and at low cost
item.description: OpenAI announced GPT-6.1 Terra, available to Plus, Pro, Enterprise and Edu ChatGPT Work and Codex users, at $1 per million input tokens via API.

item.title: North Korean artillery pointed south stirs concern at border observatory
item.description: Visitors to a South Korean observatory saw North Korean artillery pointed south, as tensions rise after a September mine blast wounded three South Korean soldiers.

item.title: With Anthropic's 'largest IPO in history' imminent, Australia's largest bank may reap windfall of tens of billions of Australian dollars
item.description: Commonwealth Bank of Australia, which joined Anthropic's March 2025 funding round, is expected to sell shares as its stake grew to A$1.53 billion.

item.title: Attackers Hijack Dahua IP Cameras in Ukraine Using P2P Access and Auth Weaknesses
item.description: Ukraine's CERT-UA warns attackers are hijacking Dahua cameras and DVRs, mainly through the Easy4IP peer-to-peer platform and predictable serial numbers.

item.title: Nvidia to invest $3B in Meta stock, expand AI collaboration on Muse models
Circle faces up to 20% revenue risk from AI agents, Mizuho says
item.description: Mizuho cites a 10-20% medium-term downside risk to Circle's reserve revenue, as AI agents steer USDC holders toward higher-yielding fiat alternatives. Why it matters: A possible revenue hit for Circle as AI agents shift USDC holders elsewhere matters to markets and crypto investors.

item.title: GitHub rival Entire launches code hosting for AI agents
item.description: Entire, a GitHub rival, launched code hosting for AI agents, offering private repository hosting in the US, the EU, India, and Australia. Why it matters: A GitHub alternative built for AI agents, with private repositories hosted in several regions, relevant to agent developers.
